records.title: S&P 500 Futures Dip With No Iran Deal, Oil Steady: Markets Wrap
records.summary: US equity-index futures edged lower and oil held gains as efforts to revive a peace deal with Iran showed little progress.

records.title: Oil Holds Biggest Gain in a Month on Standoff in US-Iran Talks
records.summary: Oil steadied after its biggest gain in about a month, as uncertainty about the state of US-Iran peace talks raised the risk that energy flows from the Persian Gulf could be curtailed for longer.

records.title: Australian Wheat Crop Expected to Drop 26% on Weather, War Costs
records.summary: Australia’s winter wheat crop is forecast to fall by more than a quarter in the 2026/27 season due to unusually dry weather, low global prices and higher input costs resulting from the war in the Middle East.

records.title: Anthropic’s First-Mover IPO Edge Set to Widen Lead Over OpenAI
records.summary: Anthropic PBC pulled ahead of OpenAI with its confidential IPO filing Monday, as the free-spending artificial intelligence startups battle for a fundraising edge that’s set to determine who will win the ultimate battle for computing power.

records.title: Elliott Takes Stake in Miner Northern Star, Pushing for Review
records.summary: Elliott Investment Management LP has built a large stake in Northern Star Resources Ltd. and is pushing for a strategic review and leadership changes at the Australian mining company.
